scenario_description:
Objective: Have tomorrow’s raw-clay delivery use the alley-side hand-truck drop at the detached studio rather than a curbside unload.
Emerging Need: The west alley bay must be clear for the future delivery, and a neighbor’s locked trailer later occupies that required space.
Decision Context: Stored delivery notes and contact records identify why curbside is unsuitable, who owns the trailer, the no-code move-request route, and the timing window.
Consequence: Once the delivery manifest locks without alley clearance, the shipment can still arrive, but the studio-side unload prerequisite is unavailable.

parameter.title: Raw clay delivery to detached studio
parameter.description: Laguna Clay order scheduled for alley-side hand-truck drop at the detached studio.
parameter.location: West alley bay by detached studio

parameter.subject: Tomorrow clay delivery route note
parameter.body: Tomorrow’s clay delivery is on the Santa Fe route. The driver can use the alley-side hand-truck drop only if the west bay is clear at arrival; otherwise the manifest defaults to curbside unload. Route notes lock at 10:45 Mountain today.

parameter.content: I just walked past your west alley bay after returning the shelf boards. Pilar’s silver utility trailer is parked across the hand-truck opening, tongue locked, and I don’t see her outside.

parameter.subject: Clay delivery manifest closing soon
parameter.body: The Santa Fe driver manifest is being finalized shortly. Any alley-side delivery with a known bay obstruction needs clearance before the 10:45 route-note lock; otherwise it will be assigned curbside unload for tomorrow.

parameter.subject: Clay delivery manifest locked
parameter.body: The Santa Fe manifest is now locked. Because alley clearance was not on the route note before cutoff, tomorrow’s clay delivery is assigned to curbside unload rather than the studio-side hand-truck drop.
